title: Lead Supplier Quality Engineer
jobDescription: Job Description Job Summary Quality Lead plays a critical role in ensuring product and process quality across the organization. This position acts as a key liaison between customers, suppliers and internal teams, supporting the resolution of quality concerns, facilitating new product introduction (NPI) and managing product changes. The role requires close collaboration with the Bearward Engineering team in India and regular communication with the UK-based Quality Manager. Key Responsibilities: Management of the QMS Including Processes, Internal, External Audits, MRM's for BE India, Serves as the primary point of contact for customer and supplier quality issues. Manage customer concerns, product changes, and new product introductions. Monitoring the COPQ for Customers. Manage Internal inspection process (Incoming, In process and Final) with Third party inspector. Develop and implement quality standards and ensure compliance across operations. Conduct internal process audits and collaborate with teams to resolve issues. Drive initiatives to reduce internal costs related to poor quality. Monitor and reduce customer complaints through long-term corrective actions. Ensure compliance with regulatory and ISO 9001 requirements. Supplier RSA, Onboarding Audits, PPAP, Performance monitoring. Contract Manufacturer performance management. Customer PPAP Report key quality metrics to internal stakeholders. Build and maintain strong customer relationships. Oversee supplier quality management and inspection operations. Coordinate site visits with internal and subcontract service engineers. Qualifications and Skills: Bachelor's degree in engineering or a relevant field. 8–10 years of experience in a quality engineering role, preferably in a manufacturing or engineering environment. Experience in supplier qualification audits, especially in high horsepower diesel engine markets. Familiarity with cooling systems and heat exchangers for the power generation sector. Strong understanding of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems. Strong understanding of PPAP, APQP. Proficiency in quality tools and software (e.g., MRP systems, CAPA, FMEA, 8D, RCA). Experience with Lean or Six Sigma methodologies (certification desirable). Capable of managing supplier and customer quality, including Level 3 PPAP and warranty coordination. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global teams. Willingness to travel within India as required. title: Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Job Description It's not just about your career or job title… It's about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it's for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you're in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us. Who are we? Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems. Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers' potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more! Role Summary/Purpose The Wabtec Data & Analytics (D&A) team is driving the company's next-generation data and analytics ecosystem with a strong focus on Data Democratization, Self-Service, and AI-led innovation. We are seeking a Data Scientist with strong SQL expertise and experience across data engineering, AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Data Science to enable scalable, governed, and intelligent self-service solutions. In addition to building and curating trusted datasets, this role will contribute to the development of AI-powered solutions leveraging Microsoft Copilot, Denodo AI SDK, Dataiku, and Agentic AI frameworks to enhance data discovery, analytics, automation, and business decision-making. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting advanced analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and Generative AI solutions that accelerate business value and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), agent development, and advanced analytics , enabling business users to effectively leverage data and AI capabilities through trusted, self-service platforms and intelligent automation solutions. Essential Responsibilities As a Data scientist, you will be responsible for the following: Partner with D&A leadership and business stakeholders to evolve and execute the Data Self-Service and Data Democratization strategy. Work directly with functional users to understand self-service data needs across data discovery, reporting, analytics, and advanced use cases. Design, build, and curate high-quality datasets to support analytics and reporting use cases, including development of curation tables. Strong Experience in SQL and PL/SQL Create and maintain data documentation, user guides, and standards in SharePoint to promote adoption and consistent usage. Develop and publish logical and physical data models and ER diagrams to support self-service and semantic layers. Collaborate with architecture and emerging technology teams on proof-of-concept evaluations of new data, analytics, and AI platforms. Help assess whether self-service tools are being used correctly, and guide users toward the most effective tools for their use cases. Contribute to self-service design patterns, implementation standards, and roadmaps based on business usage patterns. Ensure self-service solutions meet enterprise requirements for data quality, metadata, semantic consistency, and performance. Work with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure data access is governed appropriately for business confidential and sensitive data. Support implementation of new and existing standards, processes, and best practices across data engineering and analytics platforms. Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear, business-oriented terms. Strong Experience in data modeling concepts and tools such as ERwin or ER Studio. The Engineering Manager shall lead the development and growth of Wabtec's Brake Electronics capability in India for Transit applications. This role is responsible for building a strong, self‑sufficient engineering team, reducing dependence on the European Centers of Competence (CoC), and enabling high‑quality, customer‑focused execution across the full brake electronics lifecycle. The role combines deep technical leadership, people management, and strategic capability development. The successful candidate will lead a team of approximately 10 Electronics Engineers, while working closely with global stakeholders, including the European CoC, systems engineering, software, validation, manufacturing, and customer project teams. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Ownership Provide technical leadership for brake electronics systems used in transit applications, including: ECU / electronic control units Power electronics and I/O modules Sensors, actuators, and communication interfaces Safety‑critical electronics for braking systems Act as the India engineering point‑of‑contact for brake electronics architecture, design decisions, and technical reviews. Ensure designs meet Wabtec standards, applicable railway norms (e.g., EN, IEC), and safety requirements for brake systems. Support system‑level trade‑off decisions in collaboration with brake systems, software, and validation teams. Capability Building & Localization Strategy Drive the strategic development of brake electronics capability in India, with a clear roadmap to: Increase end‑to‑end design ownership within the India team Systematically reduce reliance on European Centers of Competence (CoC) Improve speed, cost efficiency, and customer responsiveness Lead and execute Transfer of Technology (ToT) initiatives from European CoC to India, including: Structured knowledge transfer plans covering architecture, design rationale, lessons learned, and legacy platforms Progressive transfer of responsibility from support roles to full ownership Ensuring long‑term capability retention beyond individual projects or people Establish and institutionalize best practices, design guidelines, templates, and technical review processes for brake electronics engineering in India. Work closely with supplier engineering teams to strengthen local capability by: Engaging key electronic component and system suppliers early in the design phase Supporting supplier technical reviews, design validations, and problem resolution Enabling alignment between Wabtec engineering requirements and supplier capabilities Collaborate with sourcing, quality, and manufacturing teams to support supplier localization strategies where appropriate, without compromising safety, quality, or compliance. Continually assess skill gaps and capability maturity in the India team and define targeted training, mentoring, and exposure plans to close them. Act as a bridge between global and regional stakeholders to ensure consistent application of global standards while enabling local execution autonomy. Team Leadership & People Development Lead, mentor, and manage a team of ~10 Electronics Engineers. Develop technical depth, system thinking, and domain expertise within the team. Perform regular performance reviews, coaching, and career development planning. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, and collaboration. Develop and maintain automated test scripts and automation frameworks using Python, LabVIEW, TestStand, or equivalent technologies. Prepare and present test plans, test results, and quality metrics to stakeholders, technical leads, and architects. Support regression testing activities for new software releases and product updates. Ensure compliance with applicable railway industry standards, quality processes, and engineering procedures. Contribute to invention disclosures and intellectual property development that provide competitive advantages to the business. Maintain accurate and complete technical documentation in accordance with engineering policies, procedures, and quality management systems. Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and software testing lifecycle (STLC). Experience with requirement-based testing and traceability management.
